title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
description: Thick, juicy bone-in pork chops seared golden in a skillet and basted with garlic, thyme and butter. Dinner in 25 minutes.

image.alt: Two golden seared pork chops with thyme and garlic

steps.text: Pat the chops very dry and season all over with the salt and pepper. If you have time, leave them uncovered in the fridge for an hour or up to a day.
Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the chops and sear without moving until deeply browned, {time 4-5 min}.
Flip and lower the heat to medium. Add the butter, garlic and thyme.
Tilt the pan and spoon the foaming butter over the chops again and again until they read {temp 140F internal} near the bone, {time 4-6 min}.
Rest the chops on a plate for {time 5 min}; they’ll rise to {temp 145F internal}, slightly pink and juicy. Spoon the garlic butter over them to serve.

notes: Pork is safe at 145°F with a 3-minute rest. Cooking it much beyond that is what makes chops dry.
Thin chops cook in half the time; watch them closely.
